differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic indices with normal hemoglobin in an elderly patient raise concern for occult GI blood loss (e.g., colorectal cancer).

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Age > 70 with combined anemia and thrombocytopenia (low platelet count/MPV) suggests a clonal marrow disorder.

differential.name: Aplastic anemia
differential.rationale: Pancytopenic picture (low platelets, borderline anemia) could reflect marrow failure despite relatively preserved hemoglobin.

differential.name: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP)
differential.rationale: Isolated severe thrombocytopenia with low MPV points to peripheral platelet destruction; anemia may be incidental.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic inflammation from social stressors or undiagnosed comorbidities can cause normocytic‑to‑microcytic anemia with modest platelet changes.
